what.text: This page follows refugees from Comoros in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2338 Comorian refugees, and France hosted 98.4% of them.
After France, the largest hosts are Germany, the United States and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Comoros in 1989 and over Anjouan territory in 1997.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2021 to 2025, come long after those conflicts.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1989 at 5 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
